transcriber_notes: 706x1046 JPEG screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form (English labels), no app branding -> source_format 'other'. File name 'Tak Falls 2013-03-06'; Location field blank so site_name null. Printed date 06/03/2013 read D/M/Y as in the other SnowPro screenshots; agrees with the file name. Height axis 2.70 px/cm (10 cm gridlines, 250 cm at y=300, 0 at y=975); boundaries from the thick blue bar lines at 201/190/167.2/142.0/87.2/61.3/33.1/24.3 -> 201/190/167/142/87/61/33/24 (+-0.5 cm), matching the table H-column leaders one-to-one. Hardness axis geometric, bars grow leftward from the right edge x=330: F/4F/1F/P/K at 13/27/54/108/216 px; bar widths 27 (4F), 54 (1F), 67 (1F+), 108 (P), 148 (P+), 67 (1F+); every reading agrees with the R-column symbols (/, X, X+, //, //+). Temperature axis 13.5 px/C with 0 C at x=303 (4F gridline, -20 at x=33); hollow circle markers read to +-0.1 C where clear (190-150 cm, outside the hatching) and +-0.2 C inside the hatched bars (140, 130, 120, 100, 50 cm; the 120 cm marker is faint), bottom marker at 0 cm is half cut by the axis (+-0.2 C). No marker at the surface; the dashed segment above 190 cm runs to the top of the axis and is not a snow temperature. Printed Surface Temp -5.1 C is in header notes (no marker drawn at 201 cm). theta (moisture), HW and rho columns blank for all layers.
